entries.en: <mothertongue l="mex" m="Hola." b="" a=" It's me."/>
entries.ro: <mothertongue l="mex" m="Hola." b="" a=" Sunt eu."/>

entries.en: Listen man… no… Can't today… Got a funeral… What? Yeah, I'd love to… No. My brother.
entries.ro: Ascultă, frate… nu… Azi nu pot… Am o înmormântare… Ce? Da, mi-ar plăcea… Nu. Fratele meu.

entries.en: <mothertongue l="mex" m="Gracias..." b="Fuck… I mean I just can't… " a=" No… You don't have to."/>
entries.ro: <mothertongue l="mex" m="Gracias..." b="Futu-i… Adică pur și simplu nu pot… " a=" Nu… Nu trebuie."/>

entries.en: My sister… She only got me!
entries.ro: Sora mea… Doar pe mine o are!
